G0400.def:
ἀνα-φωνέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for שָׁמַע hi., זָכַר hi. ;]
to cry out, exclaim: Lc 1:42 (Arist., al.).†
(AS)

G0401.def:
ἀνά-χυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναχέω, to pour out),
a pouring out, overflowing, excess: metaphorically, 1Pe 4:4 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0402.def:
ἀνα-χωρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for בָּרַח, נוּם, etc. ;]
__1. to go back.
__2. to withdraw: Mt 9:24; frequently in sense of avoiding danger (MM, VGT, see word), Mt 2:12 (but see Thayer), Mt 2:13-14, 22 4:12 12:15 14:13 15:21 27:5, Mc 3:7, Jo 6:15, At 23:19 26:31.†
(AS)

G0404.def:
ἀνα-ψύχω
[in LXX for נָפַשׁ ni., חָיָה, etc. (frequently in sense of revive, refresh oneself) ;]
to refresh: with accusative of person(s), 2Tm 1:16 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 588).†
(AS)

G0405.def:
ἀνδραποδιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀνδράποδον, a slave, captured in war)
a slave-dealer, kidnapper: 1Tm 1:10 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0407.def:
ἀνδρίζω
[in LXX for חָזַק אָמַץ (Js 1:6 ff., 1Cr 22:19, al.; in 2Rs 10:12, Sl 27:14 31:24 combined with κρατιοῦσθαι, as in 1Co, l.with) ;]
to make a man of. Mid., to play the man (cf. MM, VGT, see word): 1Co 16:13.†
(AS)

G0409.def:
ἀνδρο-φόνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: 2Ma.9:28 * ;]
a man-slayer: 1Tm 1:9 (cf. φονεύς, and see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0410.def:
ἀν-έγκλητος, -ον
(ἀ-, ἐγκαλέω), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:31 * ;]
not to be called to account, unreprovable: 1Co 1:8, Cl 1:22, 1Tm 3:10, Tt 1:6-7.†
SYN.: ἄμεμπτος, ἀνεπίλημπτος (see Tr., Syn., § ciii; Cremer, 742; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

G0414.def:
αν-εκτός, -όν
(also in late Gk. -ή, -όν; ἀνέχομαι),
tolerable: compar., -ότερος, Mt 10:15 11:22, 24, Lc 10:12, 14 †
(AS)

G0415.def:
ἀν-ελεήμων, -ον
(-ἀ, ἐλεήμων), [in LXX for אַכְזָר ;]
without mercy: Rm 1:13.†
(AS)

G0416.def:
ἀνεμίζω = Attic ἀνεμόω
(ἄνεμος);
pass.,
to be driven by the wind: Tg 1:6.†
(AS)

G0417.def:
ἄνεμος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for רוּחַ ;]
wind: Mt 11:7 14:24, 30 14:32, Mc 4:37, 39 4:41 6:48, 51, Lc 7:24 8:23-24, Jo 6:13, At 27:7, 14-15, Tg 3:4, Ap 6:13 7:1; pl., Mt 7:25, 27 8:26-27, Lc 8:25, At 27:4, Ju 12; οἱ τέσσαρες ἄ. τῆς γῆς, Ap 7:1; hence the four quarters of the heavens (see Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, see word), Mt 24:31, Mc 13:27; metaphorically, of variable teaching, Eph 414.†
SYN.: πνεῦμα, πνοή (and cf. θύελλα, λαῖλαψ). (AS)

G0419.def:
ἀνεξεραύνητος
(Rec. -εύνητος, as in Attic; M, Pr., 46), -ον (ερευνάω), [in Sm. (-ευ-): Pr., 25:3 * ;]
unsearchable: Rm 11:33.†
(AS)

G0420.def:
ἀνεξί-κακος, -ον
(fut., ἀνέξομαι, κακός)
patiently forbearing (cf. ἀνεξικακία, Wis.2:19; and see MM, VGT, see word): 2Tm 2:24.†
(AS)

G0421.def:
ἀνεξιχνίαστος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἐξιχνιάζω, to track out; ἴχνος) [in LXX: Jó 5:9 9:10 34:24 (חֵקֶר אַיִן)* ;]
that cannot be traced out: Rm 11:33, Ef 3:8 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0423.def:
ἀν-επί-λημπτος (Rec. -λμπτος; Bl., § 6, 8), -ον
(ἀ- ἐπιλαμβάνω)
without reproach: 1Tm 3:2 5:7 6:14.†
SYN.: ἀμεμπτος, ἀνέγκλητος. It is stronger than these, for it implies not only that the man is of good report, but that he is deservedly so (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

G0424.def:
ἀν-έρχομαι
[in LXX: 3Ki.13:12 (הָלַךְ)* ;]
to go up: Jo 6:3, Gl 1:17-18 (cf. ἐπανέρχ-; and on its use of "going up " to the capital, MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0425.def:
ἄνεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνίημι), [in LXX: 2Es.4.22 (שָׁלוּ), 2Cr 23:15, I Et 4:62, Wis.13:13, Sir.15:20 26:10 * ;]
a loosening, relaxation: At 24:23 (RV, indulgence; cf. MM, VGT, see word); by St. Paul, opposite to θλίψις, expressed or understood, relief: 2Co 2:12 7:5 8:13, 2Ts 1:7.†
SYN.: ἀνάπαυσις (which see).† (AS)

G0426.def:
ἀν-ετάζω
(ἀνά, ἐτάζω, to examine; see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: Jz 6:29 (דָּרַשׁ), Et 2:23 (בָּקַשׁ), Da TH Su 1:14 * ;]
to examine judicially: At 22:24, 29..†
(AS)

G0427.def:
ἄνευ
prep. with genitive (rarer than χωρίς, which see; cf. Ellic. on Ef 2:12; MM, VGT, 42),
without: Mt 10:29, 1Pe 3:1 4:9.†
(AS)

G0428.def:
ἀν-εύ-θετος, -ον
(see MM, VGT, see word)
not well placed, not fit: At 27:12.†
(AS)

G0429.def:
ἀν-ευρίσκω
(ἀνά, εὑρίσκω), [in LXX: 4Ma.3:14 * ;]
to find out by search, discover (see Field, Notes, 47 f.): Lc 2:16, At 21:4.†
(AS)

G0430.def:
ἀν-έχω
[in LXX chiefly for אָפַק hithp. ;]
to hold up; in NT always mid., to bear with, endure: in cl. most frequently with accusative, but in NT with genitive of person(s), Mt 17:17, Mc 9:19, Lc 9:41, 2Co 11:1 11:19, Ef 4:2, Cl 3:13; before μικρόν τι, with genitive of person(s) and with genitive of thing(s), 2Co 11:1; with dative of thing(s), 2Ts 1:4 (v M, Th., in l); before εἴ τις, 2Co 11:20; absol., 1Co 4:12, 2Co 11:4; to bear with = to listen to, with genitive of person(s), At 18:14; with genitive of thing(s), 2Tm 4:3, Hb 13:22 (cf. προσανέχω and MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0431.def:
ἀνεψιός, -οῦ, ὁ
(cf. Lat. nepos), [in LXX: Nm 36:11 ( בֵּן דּוֹד), Tob.7:2 9:6 א * ;]
a cousin: Cl 4:10 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0432.def: anise, dill , (Aristophanes Comicus); ionic ἄννησον or ἄνησον (Herdotus Historicus); aeolic ἄννητον, or ἄνητον, (Sapho). (ML)

G0433.def:
ἀν-ήκω
(ἀνά, ἥκω), [in LXX: Js 23:14 (בּוֹא), 1Rs 27:8, Sir. prol.10, 1, 2 Mac6* ;]
prop., to have come up to; in later writers, impers. it is due, it is befitting: in ethical sense (MM, VGT, see word), Ef 5:4, Cl 3:18; τὸ ἀνῆκον, Phm 8.†
(AS)

G0435G.def:
ἀνήρ, ἀνδρός, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ, frequently אֱנוֹשׁ, also אָדָם, etc. ;]
a man, Lat. vir.
__1. As opposite to a woman, At 8:12, 1Tm 2:12; as a husband, Mt 1:16, Jo 4:16, Rm 7:2, Tt 1:6.
__2. As opposite to a boy or infant, 1Co 13:11, Ef 4:13, Tg 3:2.
__3. In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, Lc 5:8; ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; frequently in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, At 1:16; and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, At 22:3; ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, 19:35.
__4. In general, a man, a male person: = τις, Lc 8:41, At 6:11.
SYN.: ἄνθρωπος, which see (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

G0435H.def:
ἀνήρ, ἀνδρός, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ, frequently אֱנוֹשׁ, also אָדָם, etc. ;]
a man, Lat. vir.
__1. As opposite to a woman, At 8:12, 1Tm 2:12; as a husband, Mt 1:16, Jo 4:16, Rm 7:2, Tt 1:6.
__2. As opposite to a boy or infant, 1Co 13:11, Ef 4:13, Tg 3:2.
__3. In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, Lc 5:8; ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; frequently in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, At 1:16; and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, At 22:3; ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, 19:35.
__4. In general, a man, a male person: = τις, Lc 8:41, At 6:11.
SYN.: ἄνθρωπος, which see (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

G0436.def:
ἀνθ-ίοτημι
(ἀντί, ἵστημι), [in LXX for עָמַד, יָצַב, etc. ;]
__1. in pres., impf., fut. and 1 aor. act., causal, to set against.
__2. In mid, and pass., also pf. and 2 aor. act., to withstand, resist, oppose: with dative, Mt 5:39, Lc 21:15, At 6:10 13:8, Rm 9:19 13:2, Gl 2:11, Ef 6:13, 2Tm 3:8 4:15, Tg 4:7, 1Pe 5:9.†
(AS)

G0437.def:
ἀνθ-ομολογέομαι, -οῦμαι
(ἀντί, ὁμολογέομαι) [in LXX: Sl 79:13 (יָדָה), Dan LXX 4:34 (שְׁבַח), I Et 8:91, Sir.20:2, 3Ma.6:33 * ;]
__1. to make a mutual agreement (Dem., Polyb.).
__2. to acknowledge fully, confess (Diod., Polyb., cf. 1Esdras, l.with).
__3. C. dative of person(s), to declare one's praises, speak fully in prayer or thanksgiving, give thanks to (cf. Ps, l.with): Lc 2:38 (Cremer, 771; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0438.def:
ἄνθος, -εος, τό
[in LXX for צִיץ, etc. ;]
a flower: Tg 1:10-11. 1Pe 1:24" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G0439.def:
ἀνθρακιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(ἄνθραξ), [in LXX: Sir.11:32, 4Ma.9:20 * ;]
a heap of burning coals: Jo 18:18 21:9.†
(AS)

G0440.def:
ἄνθραξ, -ακος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for גֶּחֶל ;]
coal, charcoal: . ἄ. πυρός, a burning coal, Rm 12:20.†
(AS)

G0441.def:
ἀνθρωπ-άρεσκος, -ον
(ἄνθρωπος, ἄρεσκος, pleasing), [in LXX: Sl 53:5 * ;]
studying to please men: Ef 6:6, Cl 3:22 (Cremer, 642; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0442.def:
ἀνθρώπινος, -η, ον
(ἄνθρωπος), [in LXX for אָדָם, אֱנוֹשׁ ;]
human, belonging to man: χεῖρες, At 17:25; σοφία, 1Co 2:13; φύσις, Tg 3:7; κτίσις, 1Pe 2:13 (MM, VGT, see word); ἀ. ἡμέρα, opposite to ἡ ἡμ. (1Co 3:13, God's Judgment-Day), human judgment, 1Co 4:3 (see Lft., Notes, 198); πειρασμὸς ἀ., temptation such as man can bear (AV, such as is common to man, see Field, Notes, 175), 1Co 10:13; ἀνθρώπινον λέγω, I speak in human fashion, with words not properly weighed, Rm 6:19 (see Field, Notes, 156).†
(AS)

G0443.def:
ἀνθρωποκτόνος, -ον
(κτείνω, to kill)
a murderer, manslayer (Eur.; see MM, VGT, see word): Jo 8:44, 1Jo 3:16.†
SYN.: φονεύς, ἀνδροφόνος (see Tr., Syn, § 83) (AS)

G0444.def:
ἄνθρωπος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ ,אָדָם, also for אֱנוֹשׁ, etc. ;]
man:
__1. generically, a human being, male or female (Lat. homo): Jo 16:21; with art., Mt 4:4 12:35, Mc 2:27, Jo 2:25, Rm 7:1, al; disting. from God, Mt 19:6, Jo 10:33, Cl 3:23, al.; from animals, etc., Mt 4:19, Lc 5:10, Ap 9:4, al.; implying human frailty and imperfection, 1Co 3:4; σοφία ἀνθρώπων, 1Co 2:5; ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαι, 1Pe 4:2; κατὰ ἄνθρωπον περιπατεῖν, 1Co 3:3; κατὰ ἄ. λέγειν (λαλεῖν), Rm 3:5, 1Co 9:8; κατὰ ἄ- λέγειν, Gl 3:15 (cf. 1Co 15:32, Gl 1:11); by meton., of man's nature or condition, ὁ ἔσω (ἔξω) ἄ., Rm 7:22, Ef 3:16, 2Co 4:16 (cf. 1Pe 3:4); ὁ παλαιὸς, καινὸς, νέος ἄ., Rm 6:6, Ef 2:15 4:22, 24 Cl 3:9, 10; joined with another subst., ἄ. ἔμπορος, a merchant, Mt 13:45 (WH, txt. om. ἄ.); οἰκοδεσπότης, Mt 13:52; βασιλεύς, 18:23; φάγος, 11:19; with name of nation, Κυρηναῖος, Mt 27:32; Ἰουδαῖος, At 21:39; Ῥωμαῖος, At 16:37; pl. οἱ ἄ., men, people: Mt 5:13, 16 Mc 8:24, Jo 4:28; οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων, Mc 11:2, 1Tm 6:16.
__2. Indef., ἄ. = τις, some one, a man: Mt 17:14, Mc 12:1, al.; τις ἄ., Mt 18:12, Jo 5:5, al.; indef. one (Fr. on), Rm 3:28, Gl 2:16, al.; opposite to women, servants, etc., Mt 10:36 19:10, Jo 7:22, 23.
__3. Definitely, with art., of some particular person; Mt 12:13, Mc 3:5, al.; οὗτος ὁ ἄ., Lc 14:30; ὁ ἄ οὗτος, ἐκεῖνος, Mc 14:71, Mt 12:45; ὁ ἄ. τ. ἀνομίας, 2Ts 2:3; ἄ τ. θεοῦ (of Heb. אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים), 1Tm 6:11, 2Tm 3:17, 2Pe 1:21; ὁ υἰὸς τοῦ ἀ., see: υἱός.
SYN.: ἀνήρ, which see (and cf. MM, VGT, 44; Cremer, 103, 635). (AS)

G0446.def:
ἀνθύπατος -ου, ὁ
(ἀντί, ὕπατος, altern. for ὑπέρτατος),
supreme, a consul, one acting in place of a consul, a proconsul, the administrator of a senatorial province (cf. ἡγεμών, and see MM, VGT, 44): At 13:7-8, 12 18:12 19:38.†
(AS)

G0447.def:
ἀν-ίημι
(ἀνά, ἵημι), [in LXX for רָפָה, נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
__1. to send up, produce, to send back.
__2. to let go, leave without support: Hb 13:5 (cf. Dt 31:6; Hom., Iliad., ii, 71).
__3. to relax, loosen (see Field, Notes, 124 f.): At 16:26 27:40; hence, metaphorically, to give up, desist from: Ef 6:9.†
(AS)

G0448.def:
ἀν-έλεος, -ον (Attic ἀνηλεής, ἀνελεήμων; MM, VGT, see word),
merciless: Tg 2:13.†
(AS)

G0450.def:
ἀνίστημι (ἀνά, ἵστημι),
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
__1. causal, in fut. and 1 aor. act., with accusative, to raise up: At 9:41; from death, Jo 6:39, At 2:32; to raise up, cause to be born or appear: Mt 22:24, At 3:22, 26.
__2. Intrans., in mid. and 2 aor act.;
__(a) to rise: from lying, Mc 1:35; from sitting, Lc 4:16; to leave a place, Mt 9:9; pleonastically, as Heb. קוּם, before verbs of going, Mc 10:1, al. (see Dalman, Words, 23; M, Pr., 14); of the dead, Mt 17:23, Mc 8:31; before ἐκ νεκρῶν, Mt 17:9, Mc 9:9;
__(b) to arise, appear: At 5:36, Rm 15:12 (cf. ἐπ-, ἐξ- ἀνίστημι, and see Cremer, 306, 738; MM, VGT, see word).
SYN.: ἐγείρω.
(AS)

G0452.def:
Ἄννας, -α (FlJ, Ἄνανος, -ου), ὁ (Heb. חָנַן),
Annas, the high priest: Lc 3:2, Jo 18:13-24, At 4:6.†
(AS)

G0453.def:
ἀ-νόητος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., νοητός; νοέω), [in LXX: Pv 17:28 (אֱוִיל), Sir.42:8, al. ;]
__1. not thought on, not understood (Hom., Plat.).
__2. not understanding, foolish (Hdt., al., LXX): Lc 24:25, Rm 1:14, Gl 3:1, 3, 1Tm 6:9, Tt 3:3 (Cremer, 438, 790; MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: ἀσύνετος (see Tr., Syn., § LXXv) (AS)

G0454.def:
ἀνοια, -ας, ἡ
(ἄ-νοος, without understanding), [in LXX: Pv 14:8, 2215 (אִוֶּלֶת), Wis.15:18, al. ;]
folly, foolishness: 2Tm 3:9; expressed in violent rage (cf. Plat., Tim., 86B): Lc 6:11.†
(AS)

G0455.def:
ἀν-οίγω
(ἀνά, οἴγω = οἴγνυμι) [in LXX chiefly for פָּתַח ;]
to open;
__1. trans., with accusative; a door or gate, At 5:19 12:14, Ap 4:1; pass., At 12:10 16:26-27; metaphorically of opportunity or welcome, At 14:27, Cl 4:3, Ap 3:20; pass., 1Co 16:9, 2Co 2:12, Ap 3:8; absol. (sc. θύραν), At 5:23 12:16; with dative of person(s), Lc 12:36, Jo 10:3; metaphorically, Mt 7:7-8 25:11, Lc 11:9-10 13:25, Ap 3:7; θησαυρούς (Sir.43:14), Mt 2:11; τ. μνημεῖα, Mt 27:52; τάφος, Rm 3:13; τ. φρέαρ, Ap 9:2; of heaven, Mt 3:16, Lc 3:21, At 10:11, Ap 11:19 15:5 19:11; σφραγῖδα, Ap 5:9 6:1 ff. Ap 8:1; βιβλίον, βιβλαρίδιον, Lc 4:17, Ap 5:2-5 10:2, 8 20:12; τ. στόμα, Mt 17:27; id. Hebraistically (Nm 22:28, Jó 3:1, Is 50:5, al.), of beginning to speak, Mt 5:2, At 8:32, 35 10:34 18:14; before εἰς βλαιφημίας, Ap 13:6; ἐν παραβολαῖς (Sl 78:2), Mt 13:35; of recovering speech, Lc 1:64; of the earth opening, Ap 12:16; τ. ὀφθαλμoύς, At 9:8, 40; id. with genitive of person(s), of restoring sight, Mt 9:30 20:33, Jo 9:1ff; 10.21, 11:37ff ; metaphorically, At 26:18; ἀκοάς, with genitive of person(s), of restoring hearing, Mc 7:35.
__2. Intrans. in 2 pf., ἀνέῳγα (M, Pr., 154); heaven, Jo 1:51; τ. στόμα, before πρός, of speaking freely, 2Co 6:11 (cf. δι-ανοίγω and see MM, VGT, 45).†
(AS)

G0456.def:
ἀν-οικο-δομέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for בָּנָה, גָּדַר ;]
to build. again, rebuild (MM, VGT, see word): At 15:16.†
(AS)

G0457.def:
ἄνοιξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνοίγω),
an opening (in MGr., springtime): ἐν ἀ., as often as I open, Ef 6:19.†
(AS)

G0458.def:
ἀνομία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄνομος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, פֶּשַׁע, תּוֹעֵבַה, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;]
lawlessness, iniquity: Mt 7:23 13:41 23:28 24:12, Rm 6:19, 2Co 6:14, 2Ts 2:3 2:7, Tt 2:14, Hb 1:9, 1Jo 3:4; in pl. (as LXX, Sl 31:1, al.; see 131., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), of acts or manifestations of lawlessness: Rm 4:7 (LXX), Hb 10:17.†
SYN.: see: ἁμάρτημα, ἄνομος (AS)

G0459.def:
ἄ-νομος, -ον
(ἀ. neg., νόμος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;]
__1. lawless, wicked: Mc 15:28, Lc 22:37, At 2:23, 1Tm 1:9, 2Pe 2:8; ὁ ἄ., 2Ts 2:8 (= ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ἀνομίας, 2Ts 2:3).
__2. without law (= οἱ μὴ ὑπὸ νόμον, Rm 2:14): 1Co 9:21 (MM, VGT, see word).
† SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος (AS)

G0460.def:
ἀνόμως,
adv. [in LXX: 2Mac 817* ;]
__1. lawlessly (2Mac, l.with).
__2. = χωρὶς νόμου, without law: Rm 2:12.†
(AS)

G0461.def:
ἀν-ορθόω, -ῶ
(ἀνά, ὀρθόω, to set straight, set up), [in LXX chiefly for כּוּן hi. ;]
to set upright or straight again, restore: of persons, Lc 13:13, Hb 12:12; of things, σκηνήν, At 15:16 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 807).†
(AS)

G0462.def:
ἀν-όσιος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ὅσιος), [in LXX: Eze.22:9 (זִמָּה, Wis.12:4, 2Ma.7:34 2Mac 8:32, 3Ma.2:2 3Mac 5:7, 4Ma.12:11 * ;]
unholy, profane (Cremer, 464): 1Tm 1:9, 2Tm 3:2 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0463.def:
ἀνοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀνέχω, -ομαι), [in LXX: 1Ma.12:25 (RV, respite)* ;]
__1. in cl., a holding back, delaying (MM, VGT, see word).
__2. forbearance, delay of punishment: Rm 2:4 3:26.†
SYN.: μακροθυμία, ὑπομονή. ἀ., forbearance, is the result and expression of μ., which involves the idea of tolerance, long-suffering, as God with sinners. ὑ. expresses patience with respect to things, as μ. with persons; it is active as well as passive, denotes not merely endurance but perseverance (see Tr., Syn., § liii; Lft., Notes, 259, 273; DB, ii, 47). (AS)

G0464.def:
ἀντ-αγωνίζομαι depon.,
[in LXX: 4Ma.17:14 * ;]
to struggle against: before πρός, with accusative, Hb 12:4.†
(AS)

G0465.def:
ἀντ-άλλαγμα, -τος, τό
(ἀντί, ἄλλαγμα; ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מְחִיר ;]
an exchange, the price received as an equivalent for an article of commerce: Mt 16:26, Mc 8:37 (cf. Sir.26:14; and see Swete, Mk., l.with; Cremer, 90).†
(AS)

G0466.def:
ἀντ-ανα-πληρόω, -ῶ
(ἀντί, ἀναπληρόω),
to fill up in turn: Cl 1:24 (see Lft., in l; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0467.def:
ἀντ-απο-δίδωμι
(ἀντί ἀποδίδωμι), [in LXX for שָׁלַם pi., גָּמַל, שׁוּב hi., etc. ;]
to give back as an equivalent, recompense, requital (the ἀντί ex­pressing the idea of full, complete return; see Lft., Notes, 46);
__(a) in favourable sense: Lc 14:14, Rm 11:35, 1Ts 3:9;
__(b) in unfavourable sense: Rm 12:19, 2Ts 1:6, Hb 10:30.†
(AS)

G0468.def:
ἀντ-από-δομα, -τος, τό
(ἀνταποδίδωμι) [in LXX chiefly for גְּמוּל ;] ( = cl. -δοσις, which see)
requital;
__(a) in favourable sense: Lc 14:12;
__(b) in unfavourable sense: Rm 11:9.†
(AS)

G0469.def:
ἀντ-από-δοσις, -εως, ἡ
(see supr.), [in LXX chiefly for גְּמוּל, שִׁלּוּם ;]
recompense: Cl 3:24 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0470.def:
ἀντ-απο-κρίνομαι
(ἀντί, ἀποκρίνω), [in LXX: Jz 5:29, Jó 16:9 (8) Jó 32:12 (עָנָה)* ;]
to answer again, reply against: before πρός, with accusative of thing(s), Lc 14:6; with dative of person(s), Rm 9:20.†
(AS)

G0471.def:
ἀντ-εῖπον
(άντί, εἶτον), [in LXX for H7725 hi., דָבַר pi., עָנָה, etc. ;]
__2 2 aor., without present in use, to speak against, gainsay: Lc 21:15, At 4:14.†
(AS)

G0472.def:
ἀντ-ὲχω
(ἀντί, ἔχω), [in LXX for חָזַק hi., etc. ;]
__1. trans., to hold against.
__2. Intrans., to withstand. Mid. 1. in cl., to hold out against.
__3. (cf. MM, VGT, see word), to hold firmly to, cleave to: with genitive (see Bl., § 36, 2), Mt 6:24, Lc 16:13, 1Ts 5:14 (see M, Th., in l), Tt 1:9.†
(AS)

G0473.def:
ἀντί
(the ι is elided only in ἀνθ᾽ ὧν), prep. with genitive (cf. MM, VGT, see word);
__1. prop, in local sense, over against, opposite, hence
__2. instead of, in place of, for (Hom., etc.): Mt 5:38 17:27, Lc 11:11, 1Co 11:15, Hb 12:2; with artic. inf. (cl.), Tg 4:15; of succession, Mt 2:22; χάριν ἀ. χάριτος, Jo 1:16 (M, Pr., 100); of price in exchange, Hb 12:16; λύτρον ἀ. πολλῶν, Mt 20:28, Mc 10:45 (M, Pr., 105); of requital, Rm 12:17, 1Ts 5:16, 1Pe 3:9 (cf. Wis.11:15); ἀνθ᾽ ὧν, because, Lc 1:20 19:44, At 12:23, 2Ts 2:10 (cl., LXX for אֲשֶׁר תַּחַת); id. therefore (cl., LXX), Lc 12:3; ἀ. τούτου (LXX for כֵּן נַעֲרָה)Ef 5:31. As a prefix, ἀντι- (before vowels ἀντ-, ἀνθ᾽-), denotes
__(a) over against, ἀντιπέραν;
__(b) co-operation, ἀντιβάλλειν;
__(with) requital, ἀντιμισθία;
__(d) opposition, ἀντίχριστος;
__(e) substitution, ἀνθύπατος.
Compounds of ἀ. usually govern dative (B1., § 37, 7).†
(AS)

G0474.def:
ἀντι-βάλλω
[in LXX: 2Ma.11:13 * ;]
to throw in turn, exchange: metaphorically, λόγους (cf. Lat. conferre sermons; see Field, Notes, 81), Lc 24:17.†
(AS)

G0475.def:
ἀντι-δια-τίθημι
in mid, to place oneself in opposition, oppose: 2Tm 2:25 (EV; but see Field, Notes, 215 f.; cf. MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)

G0476.def:
ἀντίδικος, -ον
(δίκη), [in LXX for רִיב ;]
as subst., an opponent in a lawsuit, adversary: Mt 5:25, Lc 12:58 18:3, 1Pe 5:8 (Cremer, 696; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0478.def:
ἀντι-καθ-ίστημι
[in LXX: Dt 31:21 (עָנָה), Js 5:7, Mq 2:8 (קוּם) * ;]
__1. causal in Pres. imperfect fut. and 1 aor.; to replace, oppose.
__2. Intrans. in pass. and 2 aor. act.;
__(a) to supersede;
__(b) to resist: Hb 12:4.†
(AS)

G0480.def:
ἀντί-κειμαι
[in LXX for אָיַב, צוּר, שָׂטַן, etc. ;]
__1. to lie opposite to.
__2. to oppose, withstand, resist: with dative, Lc 13:17 21:15, Gl 5:17, 1Tm 1:10; as participial subst. (ὁ) ἀντικείμενος, 1Co 16:9, Fp 1:28, 2Ts 2:4, 1Tm 5:14 (Cremer, 746).†
(AS)

G0481.def:
ἄντικρυς
(Tr. -ύς, Rec. ἀντικρύ), adv. (ἀντί) [in LXX: Ne 12:8 (נֶגֶד), 3Ma.5:16 * ;]
in cl., outright; in κοινή (= cl. καταντικρύ), over against: At 20:15 (see Bl., § 5, 4; 40, 7; Rutherford, NPhr., 500 f.; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0482.def:
ἀντι-λαμβάνω
[frequently in LXX for חָזַק hi., סָמַךְ, etc ;]
to take instead of or in turn. Mid., with genitive, to take hold of;
__(a) of persons, to help (see MM, VGT, see word): Lc 1:54, At 20:35;
__(b) of things, to partake of: 1Tm 6:2 (see Field, Notes, 210; Cremer, 386; and cf. συν-αντιλαμβάνω).†
(AS)

G0483.def:
ἀντι-λέγω
[in LXX: Os 4:4 (רִיב hi.), Is 50:5 (סוּג ni.) Is 22:22 65:2, Sir.4:25, 3Ma.2:28, 4Ma.4:7 4Mac 8:2 * ;]
cοntradict, oppose, resist (see Field, Notes, 106; MM, VGT, see word); absol.: At 28:19, Rm 10:21, Tt 1:9 2:9; with dative, Jo 19:12, At 13:45; with accusative and inf., Lc 20:27 T; pass., Lc 2:34, At 28:22.†
(AS)

G0484.def:
ἀντί-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις; see MM, VGT see word; M, Pr., 56), -εως, ἡ
(ἀντιλαμβάνομαι) [in LXX for עֹז, זְרוֹעַ, etc., frequently in Sl 2:1-12,3Mac.; frequently also in π. in petitions to the Ptolemies in sense of βοήθεια (see Deiss., LAE, 107; BS, 92, 223) ;]
__1. cl. a laying hold of, an exchange.
__2. Hellenistic (LXX, π.) help: pl. of ministrations of deacons; 1Co 12:28 (DB, ii, 347 f.; Cremer, 386).†
(AS)

G0485.def:
ἀντιλογία, -ας ἡ
(ἀντιλέγω), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב ;]
gain-saying, strife (the latter sense being found in π.; see MM, VGT, see word; cf. Field, Notes, 106): Hb 6:16 7:7 12:3, Ju 11.†
(AS)

G0486.def: to rail at or abuse in turn , (New Testament); Mid., with accusative rei, (Lucian) (ML)

G0487.def:
ἀντί-λυτρον, -ου, τό
[in Al.: Sl 49:9 * ;]
a ransom: 1Tm 2:6 (see CGT, in l; and cf. λύτρον).†
(AS)

G0488.def:
ἀντι-μετρέω, -ῶ
to measure in return: Lc 6:38 (WH, mg., μετρέω).†
(AS)

G0489.def:
ἀντιμισθία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀντίμισθος, for a reward)
a reward, requital: in good sense, 2Co 6:13; in bad sense, Rm 1:27 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0491.def:
Ἀντιοχεύς, -έως, ὁ
a citizen of Antioch, an Antiochian: At 6:5.†
(AS)

G0492.def:
ἀντι-παρ-έρχομαι
[in LXX: Wis.16:10 * ;]
to pass by opposite to: Lc 10:31-32 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0493.def:
Ἀντίπας (T, Ἀντείπας), -α (in some MSS. it appears to be indecl.; but see M, Pv 12:1-28; it is abbrev. from Ἀντίπατρος), ὁ,
Antipas: Ap 2:13.†
(AS)

G0494.def:
Ἀντιπατρίς, -ίδος, ἡ
Antipatris, bet. Joppa and Caesarea: At 23:31.†
(AS)

G0495.def:
ἀντί-περα (Rec. ἀντιπέραν, LTr. ἀντιπέρα) adv., = cl. ἀντιπέρας (MM, VGT, 49),
on the opposite side: with genitive, Lc 8:26.†
(AS)

G0496.def:
ἀντι-πίπτω
[in LXX: Êx 26:5 (קָבַל), Êx 26:17 (שׁוּב), Nm 27:14 (מְרִיבָה) Jó 23:13 (שָׁלַב hi.) * ;]
__1. to fall against or upon (Arist., Polyb.).
__2. to strive against, resist (Arist.): with dative, At 7:51
(AS)

G0497.def:
ἀντι-στρατεύομαι
to make war against: with dative, Rm 7:23.†
(AS)

G0498.def:
ἀντι-τάσσω (Att..., -ττω)
[in LXX for לוּץ hi., נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
to range on battle against; mid., to set oneself against, resist: absol., At 18:6; with dative, Rm 13:2, Tg 4:6 5:6, 1Pe 5:5 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0499.def:
ἀντί-τυπος, -ον
(see: τύπος), [in LXX: Et 3:13 A * ;]
__1. active striking back; metaphorically, resisting, adverse.
__2. Pass. struck back; metaphorically, corres­ponding to (MM, VGT, see word);
__(a) as impression of a seal or copy of an archetype (τύπος) (RV, Like in pattern), Hb 9:24;
__(b) as the reality (of which τύπος is the copy or adumbration) (RV, after a true likeness), 1Pe 3:21 (Cramer, 357).†
(AS)
